purpose: one predeclared exploratory historical execution diagnostic, no optimization or promotion

signal.entry: RSI14(close)<30 AND close<BB20x2.lower(HLC3); no volume filter in original
signal.rsi: TA-Lib0.6.8/C0.6.4 default Wilder initialization and compatibility0, unstable0; index0..13 NaN
signal.bollinger: qtpylib at frozen commit; HLC3, rolling window20, min_periods1, sample standard deviation ddof1
signal.equality: strict RSI<30, close<lower, RSI>70; equality gives no corresponding signal
signal.warmup: full December2022 history; last warmup close signal may execute first evaluation open

risk.stop_trigger: raw low <= actual slipped entry price*0.75; gap below stop executes raw open then adverse exit slip
risk.roi_trigger: raw high >= actual entry fill*(1+entry_fee_rate)*1.10/(1-exit_fee_rate); gap above target executes raw open then adverse exit slip
risk.roi_slippage_note: trigger includes entry/exit fees but not future exit slip; exact target with2bps exit slip realizes9.978% net, not guaranteed10%

position.funding: not applicable to spot, no funding cashflow
position.market_impact: fixed slip assumption, no volume participation or exchange precision/minimum/notional model

execution.signal_time: after complete source bar closes, references only i-lag at destination open i
execution.entry: actual raw open_i*(1+0.0002), fee on executed notional, state signals may persist
execution.exit_signal: actual raw open_i*(1-0.0002) when RSI exit signal i-lag true
priority: existing inventory: due known exit signal at open
otherwise existing inventory open-gap stop or ROI
then intrabar stop before ROI, including entry bar
mark retained position at actual bar close
execution.same_bar: no reentry after exit; if flat start and source entry available, buy at open then process risk range; never execute at indicator/synthetic price
execution.path_ambiguity: count high/low range overlaps separately from true unresolved paths; known open-gap or scheduled open exits resolve chronology; inner-bar both thresholds use stop-first, OHLC cannot establish actual path
execution.delayed_signals: lag2 sensitivity references i-2 at open; delayed raw signal is acted on if flat at execution; no cancellation using future information
execution.terminal: no forced liquidation; report raw-close equity and separate hypothetical after-cost liquidation estimate
execution.risk_order_deviation: explicit independent chronological gap model; not exact Freqtrade execution, orderbook or its close-rate rounding

input.source: Binance Vision official monthly klines ZIP+CHECKSUM
input.zero_volume: must report, never silently delete or add absent source volume>0 signal filter
input.row_policy: reject missing/out-of-order/duplicate/invalid rows, no sorting/dedup/fill repairs
input.profile: explicit offline diagnostic exception per pinned batch handoff; not canonical perpetual dataset or TRUSTED load
input.finality_and_rights: full input QA and actual authorization prerequisite; no fake is_closed or vwap
input.strict_finality_blocker: Spot REST time request HTTP451; provider clock/newer-current-bucket not available, do not bypass. Archive diagnostic only.

buyhold: 95% initial cash fee-inclusive buy first evaluation open, mark same final close, no forced exit; same fee8/slip2

metrics.return: final close-marked equity/initial cash-1, includes initial fill cost
metrics.max_drawdown: negative min(hourly equity / running hourly peak including initial cash -1)
metrics.sharpe: UTC daily last hourly close returns including first day vs initial100000; sample std ddof1, rf0, sqrt365

exposure.prior_strategies: at least earlier public strategy batch; exact past search count UNKNOWN
exposure.source_asset_selection: source does not specify asset universe; BTCUSDT is predeclared illustrative instance

validation: unchanged original BbandRsi class populate methods through import-only IStrategy shim; exact indicators/signals and source risk parameters checked; full framework not run
independent stdlib RSI+BB+ledger, no primary-engine import
all hourly equity, fills, fees, PnL, signals, daily metrics
eight future perturbation cuts including intraday, Sunday and Monday boundaries
identical frozen code/input rerun to fresh directory
limitations: retrospective archive does not establish contemporaneous availability or historical PIT tradability
historically exposed window, not independent OOS
fees and fills are assumed, not account-specific
not promoted, not live-ready; no trading orders
